description: Top holders of token X on chain Y — the largest wallet holders of an ERC-20 token contract, with balances. Works across 100+ chains via Covalent/GoldRush. Example: covalent_token_holders({ token_address: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", chain: "eth-mainnet", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Covalent / GoldRush API key (free tier at goldrush.dev)

chain.description: Chain name (Covalent format), e.g. "eth-mainnet", "matic-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "bsc-mainnet", "arbitrum-mainnet". A numeric chain id also works. Default "eth-mainnet".

name: covalent_token_holders
